title: tc-lineage-graph
description:
Where an output came from: run, turns, queries and tools, source chunks, claims and artifacts in columns, every
node's record a click away.

heading.description: The heading in the bar, and the graph's name

columns.description: The columns, cause to effect – a node sits in the column its `column` names; columns without nodes don't show

nodes.description: Everything in the lineage: the run, turns, queries and tools, source chunks, claims, artifacts

edges.description: The links, from what came first to what it fed

selected.description: The node whose record is open (null = none). Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

view.description: "graph" or "chain" (the event chain). Changed by the user unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

weakLabel.description: What a weak link means – in the legend, and in a node's links when the link has no note of its own

emptyText.description: Shown when there are no nodes

tone.description: The colour of its nodes' marks

column.description: The id of the column it sits in

label.description: What it is, in a few words – e.g. "search: renewal terms 2024"

detail.description: One quieter line under the label – e.g. "policy-handbook.pdf · p. 14"

at.description: When it happened, in ms from the start of the run – orders the event chain and shows there

text.description: A passage shown in the record – the chunk's text, the claim as written

fields.description: Key–value lines shown in the record

tone.description: Overrides the column's tone for this node – e.g. a claim coloured by where it came from

LineageField.description: A line of a node's record, e.g. { label: "Score", value: "0.82" }

weak.description: A weak link – the context was truncated, so the source may not have reached the model in full. Drawn dashed

note.description: Why it's weak, e.g. "3 of 8 chunks fit the context" – shown in the record
